title: The CyberUnicorn Update tab offers a new firmware release as soon as it is published

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: the Update tab offered CU5K 0.1.4 ten minutes after 0.1.5 was published.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE: lib/devices/firmware.ts listReleases() fetched the GitHub release list with next.revalidate 300, a stale-while-revalidate cache, so the first visits after a release still got the old list and the owner was told 0.1.4 was newest. The list is now fetched with cache no-store (one small staff-only call when the Update tab opens). Manifests stay cached: a published release's manifest does not change.

verify.note: Fails when the release list fetch is cached again.
